claims: Working holiday makers are not entitled to the ${formatAUD(TAX_FREE_THRESHOLD)} tax-free threshold, regardless of how long they live in Australia.
whys: Cross-file fix proposed (and checked by a verifier) in the first fact-fix round. Proposal: Same Addy/NDA exception as line 77 of the guide. A resident WHM from an eligible NDA country pays the lower of WHM tax and resident tax, so in effect they get the tax-free threshold. Proposed: replace 'regardless of how long they live in Australia' with 'unless they are an Australian resident for tax purposes from an eligible NDA country (Chile, Finland, Germany, Israel, Japan, Norway, Turkey or the UK), who can claim resident rates when they lodge'.

claims: Your employer does not apply the offset through PAYG withholding during the year, so you receive it as a reduced assessment or larger refund when you lodge.
whys: Cross-file fix proposed (and checked by a verifier) in the first fact-fix round. Proposal: Wrong. Otherwise you receive it as a reduced assessment or larger refund when you lodge.' (keep the existing PAYG withholding Link).
